title: filaginella uliginosa subsp. sibirica
intro: Filaginella uliginosa subsp. sibirica, commonly known as Sibirian filaginella or Russian licorice, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Plumbaginaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in treating various conditions such as coughs, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Sibirian filaginella are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the body, as well as its potential to reduce fever and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research.
